name: What types of sliding door latches can be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What types of sliding door latches can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many types of sliding door latches can be repaired, including mortise latches, surface-mount latches, and hook latches found on patio, closet, and pocket doors. The feasibility of repair often depends on the specific damage; if internal components are worn or broken, replacement of the entire mechanism might be necessary rather than a simple repair. A professional can assess whether a repair or replacement is the most cost-effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard sliding door latch types, like mortise or hook latches, can be repaired, though sometimes full replacement is more practical.
